# Synthetic parser development fixtures

Five Vietnamese and five English UTF-8 CV snippets, authored for Day 07 tests.
No names, contact details, real employers or real candidate records.
These are development/regression cases, not the held-out evaluation dataset.
The filename prefix records the expected language. Negative experience and
unspecified durations are intentional; parsing must not reinterpret them.
PDF cases are generated in memory in parser tests using ReportLab/PdfWriter.
